text: Dalabrindar was a Netherese wizard. He sacrificed himself as part of one of Karsus's experiments.
Curthas was a guard in Glymril Gard during the mid–8 century DR.
Dai Rolno was a Morninglord of Amaunator that visited the Wheloon Prison in the late 15 century DR during the Shadovar invasion of Wheloon.
Dalamene Amataxos was an Eveningstar resident of Cormyr during the mid-1480s DR.
Daggerjaw was a great crocodile that lived near the ruins of Myth Drannor in the late 14 century DR.
Cyndirie Vand was a patron of the Elfsong Tavern in the city of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Cymon the Skald, better known as Cymon the False, was a famous wandering gnome singer, storyteller, and songwriter active in the Moonshae Isles as of the late 15 century DR.
Dahl Timber was a potato farmer and an alleged spy during the Harper-Reithwin conflict in the Western Heartlands of the late 14 century DR.
Daerdatha "Darkspells" was a drow sorceress involved in the infiltration of Scornubel during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Daera was a coin-lass of Athalantar in the early 3 century DR.
Dagh Lahrskald was the leader of the city of Ruathym, the largest settlement on the island of Ruathym in the Trackless Sea, as of the late 15 century DR.
King Dagdar was ruler of the Kingdom of Moray on the island of Moray in the Moonshae Isles during the early-to-mid–14 century DR.
King Dagus was ruler of the Northlander subkingdom of Olafstaad within Gnarhelm in the Moonshae Isles during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Daegon was a human druid of the Storm Horns during the late 15 century DR.
Daerego Sulphontis was a merchant of Sembia who was murdered by the Cult of the Dragon.

Cythara Nathalan was a wizardess from Evermeet in the 14 century DR. Banished alongside her younger brother Yldar Nathalan, the two of them traveled together, seeking Ynloeth's Bracer until their parting.
D'vara was a Thayan assassin gladiator and one of the pain-bringers of the Slaughterhouse Arena of Tyraturos in the very end of the 15 century DR.
Cyrando was a gnomish cleric and a friend of Garrick the bard in the mid-14 century DR.
Cyrrollalee () was the halfling deity of trust, friendship, and hospitality and at one point an exarch of Sheela Peryroyl.
Darlutheene Ambershields was the daughter of a family of servants in Suzail, Cormyr. She flitted about the Royal Court of Cormyr during much of the 14 century DR.

Damian Krale was a worshiper of Shar who was tasked by the Mistress of the Night to unite cells dedicated to her worship throughout the Western Heartlands. The ultimate goal of his endeavours was mostly a secret and only a few of the leaders of the cells knew what it was.
Damien Oneknife was a halfling thief and assassin operating in Faerûn in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Dardreth Marliir was a member of the Marliir noble family of Cormyr in the late 15 century DR.
Dalmar was a human abbot and cleric of Chauntea who led the monks of the Green Lady's Keep, a temple to Chauntea in Velprintalar, Aglarond, around 1368 DR.
High Artificer Danactar, Most Holy Servant of Gond, was the highest-ranking mortal priest of the Wonderbringer circa 1370 DR.
Danifae Yauntyrr was a stunningly beautiful drow cleric who eventually became the Yor'thae (Chosen of Lolth), a part of Lolth herself.
Danthra (often called Danthra the Dreamer, a name chosen by Khelben "Blackstaff" Arunsun) was a companion to Tsarra Chaadren, and considered Tsarra her best friend.
Damien was the son of Gaspar the Fishmonger in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale.
Dannal Harftevor was a half-elf male cavalry officer of the Amnian Council Army in Eshpurta, in the early .
Dalzhel was a human warrior of the Zhentil Keep in the mid–14 century DR. He was a lieutenant of the then-human Cyric when he entered into the service of Bane during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR.

Darkas the Storyteller was a half-elven woman who dwelled in Memnon in Calimshan through the 13th and 14th centuries DR. At over a century old by 1370 DR, she was gray-haired and had only one eye, but it remained keenly observant. She had a very good memory of her long life in Memnon, and clearly knew all the rumors and happenings about the city. The secrets she knew were suggested in her songs. She was popular with almost everyone in Memnon, and was very influential politically.
Dargin Stoneweaver was a member of the Heralds of Faerûn and an assistant to Shalara Swordshigh during her tenure as Old Night. Dargin lived in Herald's Holdfast during this time.
Dargoth was a merchant who was a member of the Peldar Merchant Fleet, but he was also one of the Wearers of the Purple of the Cult of the Dragon in Sembia.
King Daravvan was the tenth Obarskyr monarch and a king of Cormyr. He was the first son of King Sacrast and only reigned for a year. The throne passed to his brother Dorglor upon his death.
Dark Linsa was a thief in Phlan working for the Welcomers thieves guild in the late 15 century DR.
Dan Zor was a human samurai and the hereditary leader of the island kingdom of Saishu in Koryo, before becoming its governor, with the title "Master of Cheju". He was also a noted sage.
Lord Danthalus Blacksilver was a noble in Cormyr of the Blacksilver family.
Daranna Brokenspear was a high-ranking Harper ranger agent in the High Forest.
Darius Bormul VI was an envoy of Amn's Council of Six in Maztica in 1370 DR.
Dalvar Corzon was a captain of the Cormyrean Freesails in 1359 DR.
Danyig was a skilled blacksmith who lived in Manass in 1367 DR.
Darlisan the Rover was a guide and huntsman in Vaasa in the late 15 century DR. He was one of the best hunters in Vaasa as of 1480 DR.
Danreth Tallathern was a key member of the Seekers of the Dawn in Myth Drannor in the Year of the Tankard, 1370 DR.
Darrask Baergil was a member of the Riders of Mistledale in the Dalelands in the early-to-mid–14 century DR. He led the organization as Captain from 1335 to 1352 DR.

Dar Lassen was a priest of the church of Oghma, called a Namer, based in the city of Ormpur in Lapaliiya in the late 15 century DR. By around 1480 DR, Dar had gained great prosperity from work in an arts or entertainment industry.

A darkmantle was an octopus-like subterranean creature that disguised itself as a stalactite. Larger specimens were sometimes called envelopers. Darkmantles were favored by the drow deity Ghaunadaur and the orc deity Shargaas.
Dana, whose full, gnomish name was Danajustiantorala, was a crewmember of the sidewheeler Unquenchable and later a passenger aboard the hammership, the Probe.
Daran Edermath was a retired drow or half-elf adventurer who dwelt in Phandalin in the late 15 century DR.
Captain Darmin Zodge was an officer of the Flaming Fist who was stationed in the city of Baldur's Gate during the late 15 century DR.
Darlow was the name of a black bear that lived within the Harvesthome Abbey of Goldenfields during the late 15 century DR.
Darkweavers were sinister creatures native to the Plane of Shadow.
Danae Xotal was a Thayan agent who was stationed in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR.
The Dark God was a mysterious figure who defiled the Temple of Lathander in Myth Drannor and sought to obtain the Codex of the Planes from Acwellan.
Darol was a young nobleman from Cormyr circa 1357 DR who was present at the wedding of Gaylyn Wyvernspur and Frefford Wyvernspur.

Daran Highhammer was a dwarven exterminator who traveled across western Faerûn during the mid–14 century DR. He went wherever he could find work, helping folks get rid of troublesome vermin, particularly those that stood on two legs.
Dandobar Snome was the young patriarch of the noble Snome family in Waterdeep in the .
Dannika Graysteel was a scholar who studied nature and weather in the frozen lands of Icewind Dale during the late 15 century DR.

Daral Yashenti was one of the eight Great Readers of the Avowed that served Candlekeep during the late 15 century DR. As such Daral was partly responsible for the day-to-day operations of the great library. Daral was considered to be Candlekeep's resident expert on creative arts, such as literature, music and poetry, and was considered a skilled poet.
King Dalious Croam, who was also called the Errant King, was the third and final King of the Croam Dynasty who ruled the city-state of Westgate.
Dammon was a tiefling blacksmith from Elturel that was forced to live as a refugee for some time during the late 15 century DR.
Danis was a tiefling from Elturel who along with his mate Bex and others of their kind, were kicked out of Elturel following the cataclysmic event known as the Descent.
Damanda was a Talontar blightlord vampire operating in the Rawlinswood as of . She was the right hand of the Talontyr, whom she served directly.
Dalthar was a cultist of the Absolute that ventured along with her comrades into the ruins of Grymforge in the late 15 century DR.
Dalwynd Meadsbreath was an adventuring hin wizard member of the The Winter Rose from the North Faerûn.
Dana Grayrunner was a Rashemaar craftsman and shopkeeper inhabiting Immilmar in Rashemen in the .
Dar-Guran was a dangerous fell troll inhabiting the Ashenwood in Rashemen during the late 14 century DR.
Damh was a lesser deity of dance, song, and celebration who was part of the fey Seelie Court. He was also a patron and guardian deity of the satyrs, korreds, and atomies.
Dameron Keel, Merchant of Hlondeth, was a businessman from the Vilhon Reach whose opinions on his homeland became well-known before 1370 DR.

Daron was a priest of Sharess who joined Aniolon Gruanthe in his exodus from Estagund to build Lliiress in the . After the blue dragon Gerinvioch employed the Evise Jhontil to hide the town from all observation, Daron died the next morning; he cast a spell, possibly intensify sensation, to enhance his pleasure and that of his partner in their morning activities. Unfortunately, he became the first victim of the Evise Jhontil and its curse, as the spell soon killed him.
The Dancer of Life, who was also known simply as the Grandmother, was the highest ranking priestess among the faithful clergy of Shiallia, the Lady of the Woods.
Dame Edza, sometimes nicknamed Dame Edgar, was a posh gnome woman who lived in Purfbin Doogrick's home burrow in the 14 century DR.
Dannath Lisosar was a a carpenter and shopkeeper inhabiting in the city of Waterdeep in the 14 century DR.
Dar'lon Ma () was an influential member of the Red Wizards and the zulkir of enchantment in Thay as of the late 15 century DR.
Dall Nickleplate was the overseer of the Lantan-Samarach portal in the jungles of Samarlogh in the late 14 century DR.
Darbrent Amclara was a mage of Alaghôn in Turmish in the mid–14 century DR.
Darion Sulmest was a cobbler inhabiting Waterdeep, City of Splendors, during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Dami Darn was a rogue and a member of a thieves' guild, active years before the 14 century DR.
Dangus Barrowfold was co-owner alongside Elvin Elminster of Short and Tall Supplies, an equipment supply shop in Halfhap in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Dandifox was a famous hero among halflings who lived some years before the 14 century DR.
Damon Briska was an individual that lived in the Western Heartlands during the mid–15 century DR.
Danley was an industrious miner who sought to reopen ore production in Phandalin in the late 14 century DR.
Danovar Clegg was a commoner from the village of West Harbor in the Mere of Dead Men circa 1374 DR.
Dallia Urdo was a young and ambitious member of the merchant Urdo family of Westgate in the late 14 century DR.
Darhlas was a blacksmith inhabiting the town of Ashabenford in Mistledale during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Danton was a tiefling druid and a peacock breeder who lived and died in the Western Heartlands during the late 15 century DR.

Dark planetars, also known as fallen planetars, were planetars, powerful celestials from the upper planes, who had fallen from the grace of their patron deity. Some were dragged down to the depths of the Abyss, while others languished in the Prime Material plane.
Damien "Puuk" Foletto is a video game design director for [https://www.lostboysinteractive.com/ Lost Boys Interactive]. Formerly, he worked for Black Isle Studios.
Darndreth Goldsword was a nobleman of Cormyr in the late 14 century DR.
Darius was a Netherese arcanist who taught magic at the Variator's Intelligentsia in Eileanar before its destruction in .
Daramos Lauthyr was high priest of the Lady's House, the temple of Tymora in Arabel, Cormyr, in the latter half of the 14 century DR.
Fist Darbonna was a member of the Flaming Fist and a healer who served the city of Baldur's Gate in late 15 century DR.
Darlakan was a gofer in the kitchens of Castle Obarskyr in Suzail in the late 14 century DR.
Darantha was the personal maid of Lady Marantine Delcastle in the late 15 century DR.
Danthalus was a Highknight of Cormyr in the late 15 century DR.
Darla Crivens was one of the inhabitants of Reithwin, the town that once venerated Selûne in the Western Heartlands, sometime before the late 14 century DR.
Lady Darlethra Greatgaunt was an eccentric old noble lady in the late 15 century DR.

Dariel Tefoco was a member of the Flaming Fist and one of the older children of Oliver Tefoco, the proprietor of the Beehive Goods and Wares general store in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Damn 'Em All Holmwood was a duergar from the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Darkwater was a guardian water weird that remained in the ruins of Myth Drannor in the late 14 century DR.

Lady Dowager Duchess Darra de Aerindale was an aged mage member of the Order of the Eternals who originally came from the world of Oerth and eventually settled on the world of Aphonion in the Kingdom of Stream's End.

Dandarnab was a merchant from the city of Al-Ubaid in the Whamite Isles. Dandarnab represented Al-Ubaid in a series of wild conflicts between various nations and pirates of the Whamite Isles at some point prior to the mass death of the population in the .
Dannbo Indigo was a refugee child who found shelter in the Rivington neighborhood of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Sir Darras of Suzail was a human cavalier in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

Dark Stag was the local Herald stationed in Silverymoon, the Gem of the North, in the late 14 century DR. By the , the title was held by a mature woman of sharp wit who—after leaving behind the life of an adventuress—went against the typical notion of a bookish, elderly Herald. Doing her part to help maintain the city's laws, peace, and quiet, Dark Stag occasionally involved herself even in backstreet affairs.
Dar-Gar-Uus Om was one of the members of the ruling Family Oligarchy of the cross-planar city of Sphur Upra at the end of the 14 century DR.

Danilo Thann was a nobleman and wizard of Waterdeep in the mid-to-late 14 century DR and a member of House Thann, being the sixth son of Rhammas and Cassandra Thann. He was also an ex-Harper as well as a former Lord of Waterdeep and aspiring bard.He was married to Arilyn Moonblade.
Daren Timbide was a general of the Banite army stationed at Mintar in 1372 DR.

Datharian Mistwatcher was an elf hero who lived millennia before the 14 century DR. He worshiped Sehanine Moonbow. After his home city was destroyed by dark elves, he was created One Thousand Broken Dreams, a powerful magic longsword. However, he was slain in battle soon after by host of driders.

Daumar Gudenny was an ex-assassin and spy for the Bruil family of Melvaunt. During his time in the city, he also often operated within the land of Thar. A self-exiled spirit folk from Rashemen, he was obsessed with the legends of Vorbyx, the First King of Thar, as some theories surrounding him suggested that the ancient king shared his lineage.

Dauneth Marliir was a member of the Marliir noble house of Arabel, Cormyr. Dauneth Marliir was a nobleman and warrior, loyal throughout the Abraxus Affair, and was appointed to be Warden of the Eastern Marches by Azoun IV.
Davaeorn was a mage who worked for the Iron Throne during the mid–14 century DR.
Daurvos Frostbeard was a dwarf and king of the Ironstar clan.
Daruk was a human bard of the late 15 century DR and a friend of the Ikemmu merchant Tatigan Carrlock. He was said to be beloved by Shar.

Deara was a priestess of Deneir at the temple of Deneir in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the early 1360s DR. Deara desired to create the perfect scribe, and so in the temple's vaults she sculpted and animated a clay golem. In one particular test, circa 1362 DR, the golem drove a quill through a wooden writing desk, smashing it in the process. Thereafter, the golem was put to work as a guard and porter in the temple's main hall.
Davlin Hoth was a wood elf explorer of the Underdark in 1484 DR.
Daudon yn Saibh el Yakan was a nirdey, or a chief collector, for the Rundeen mercantile organization in Memnon, Calimshan, in the late 14 century DR.
Davrick Fain was the lead cultist of Auril in Icewind Dale in 1484 DR.
Deathwallow was a green hag of the Bloodroot Coven in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR.
Dathlue Mistwinter, who most knew as Lady Steel, was the founder of the Harpers at Twilight.
Dauner Ilzimmer was a member of the Ilzimmer family and the lord of Amphail sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
Dasin was an aquatic elf Dukar of the Order of Kupavi in Myth Nantar.
Duke Dashard Devlin, also known as Helmont the 14th, was the twenty-first duke of the Duchy of Carmathan in the Kingdom of Damara. He ruled during the mid–14 century DR.
Dartwell was a half-elf market grifter in Waterdeep in the 1470s DR.
Davon Malaeda was an official in Hillsfar in the late 15 century DR.
Dava was a female Tethyrian human evoker in Cormyr in the mid–14th century DR.
Darthurn was the lord of the former town of Caddarak, later known as the Hall of Four Ghosts, on the western edge of the High Forest, east of the Stone Bridge.
Lord Davien Mecatoris was the scion of House Mecatoris of Sambral, one of the Windrise Ports of Laerakond, as of 1479 DR.
Dauphal was a wandering loxo that roamed south and southeast Faerûn circa the 1370's DR.

Lord Daster Mremman was a ruler of the city of Sammaresh in Lapaliiya some time before 1373 DR. He ruled from the Mantimera Throne (named for the mantimera) and was advised by the Whispering Serpent. Daster was an ancestor of Lady Ilnara Mremman, who ruled circa 1373 DR. Daster wrote a biography titled My Years on the Mantimera Throne.
Dathan was a veteran half-elven adventurer in the 14 century DR.

Daviana Yalrannis was the master of Moongleam Tower during the late 15 century DR. Along with the tower's other residents, Daviana was a member of the Harpers. She was charged maintaining the tower's operations and ensuring its safety from any threats.
Death dogs (or deathdogs) were vicious and hateful two-headed dogs who had a taste for humanoid flesh and were infamous as spreaders of disease.

Darun Lockmaster was the only dwarven councilor within the Dale Council of High Dale in the late 14 century DR. He was known as a cheerful and intelligent man, as well as an extremely skilled armorsmith and locksmith. He was known to craft the finest locks, as well as accompanying picks, in all of the Dalelands.
Darrondar Gweth was head priest of Tempus in Daggerford around 1485 DR.
Darva was a member of the ruling triumvirate in Fireshear in the late 15 century DR.
Darwa Dalion was a Red Wizard of Thay spy residing in Daggerford around 1480 DR.
De'Tranion was a brewer in Baldur's Gate during the mid-14 century DR. He formulated a well-known brew called Baalor ale.
Daryth was a thief from Calimshan who aided Tristan Kendrick of the Moonshae Isles in the mid–14 century DR..
Daungelina Tr'arach was a drow first priestess in the early 11 century DR.
Decapuses were a species of tentacled carnivorous creatures that swung through the trees and had a marine variation.
Darthag Ulgar was a merchant of the Lionshield Coster and the operator of their trading post in Nightstone during the late 15 century DR.
Darrom Ithal of Clan Ithal was the first king of Tethyr and the founder of the Ithal Dynasty.
Darrom Ithal II was the first crown prince of the kingdom of Tethyr.
Daud yn Khadil el Marekh was the last bakkal of the Marekh Dynasty and the First Age of Calimshan.
Davey Halloran was a down on his luck commoner of Daggerford circa 1372 DR.
Darvik was a gnome inhabitant of the town of Ghars in Cormyr in the mid–14 century DR.
Dawasir was a warrior of the Mtair Dhafir tribe of Anauroch that traveled the deserts during the mid–14 century DR.
Darrun was a horse belonging to the adventuress Kendra in the mid–14 century DR. It was trained for battle.
Daunzra was a priest of Helm and member of Sir Justin Melenikus's watchers at Iniarv's Tower in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Deathcoils were massive, serpentine beasts known for their appetite. They were counted as serpents by the Scaled Ones.
Darthen Nhalass I was the fifth Arkhan of the Nhalass Dynasty to rule the nation of Raumathar.
Darthen Nhalass II was the seventh Arkhan of the Nhalass Dynasty to rule the nation of Raumathar.
Darthen Nhalass III, who was also nicknamed Fiendbane, was the tenth Arkhan of the Nhalass Dynasty to rule the nation of Raumathar.
Darvin Kordeion was a mage of Thentia. Though reluctant, he was instrumental to the effort to thwart Sammaster's plans in the Rage of Dragons of the .

Dayul was one of the Blades of the Old Man as of . On the night of Tarsakh 25, they became aware of an intruder in Sentinelspire. While they were looking out for the intruder, they came across Lewan and Ulaan. On the orders of Weilus, they tried to get them to return to their room; however, this led to a fight. Dayul's wrist was broken by a hammer blow from Lewan; after he was disabled, it was only Ulaan's intervention that kept Dayul from taking revenge on the young man. He was slain by swarming killoren shortly after.
Deamiel was a demon that served Pandorym in the late 15 century DR.

Darsson was the captain of the Halruaan skyship Stormsailer owned by the Datharathi as of . He himself was a native of Halruaa, and a wizard of enough experience to control the skyship. He took Warian Datharathi, Sevaera Datharathi and Zeltaebar Datharathi across the Golden Water on that year.
Darsh Nyach was a salesman and peer of Baldurian society in the 15th century DR.
Dathchaunt Sandrach was the Magister from to . He worked on combination spells.
Darryl Orcslayer was a successful adventurer inhabiting the city of Daggerford in the Western Heartlands in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Deanna was a barmaid inhabiting the city of Zhentil Keep during the mid–14 century DR.
Daunt Buirune was a tavern owner inhabiting the city of Waterdeep during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Dartabba Shoukyn was a member of the Phaerdinzer clan and the most likely heir to the clan as of .
Dathae was a swanmay ranger of Mielikki from Essembra in Battledale in the 12 and 13 centuries DR. She was a noted bearer of the holy Mielikkian spellbook known as Yornar's Trail Companion.
Deadly Treasure was an ankylosaurus that lived in Port Nyanzaru in Chult during the late 15 century DR.
Flame Daryn Falburn () was an officer in the Flaming Fist that served the city of Baldur's Gate during the late 15 century DR.
Darthusk was a guard in service of Mourngrym Amcathra in the mid-late 14 century DR.
Dartheema was a young woman inhabiting Waterdeep, the City of Splendors, during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Dazmilar Starbrow was the problem child of the hero Roadwarden of the Roadwarden Guard, Arelin Starbrow, active in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Dathguld Guldar was a noble lord of Westgate in the early and mid-14 century DR.
Daven was a man who lived in Baldur's Gate during the late 15 century DR.
King Davyd Snowsword was the last king of Delimbiyran, a human realm that ended with his death in 697 DR.
Lord Dawn Lurian was an infant noble of House Lurian in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the late 14 century DR.
Fist "Deadeye" Mibbs was a member of the Flaming Fist and who served the city of Baldur's Gate in late 15 century DR.
Debac was a scrupulous Netherese priest who guarded the Netheril Mint in Eileanar until its destruction in .
Darwell Kiriag was a descendant of Dunman Kiriag and the proprietor of the Lonesome Tankard Inn and Tavern in the town of Eveningstar in the 15 century DR.
Davny Selkin was a Constal of the Purple Dragons of Cormyr, who was stationed in the prison-town of Wheloon in the late 15 century DR.
Dawan Pax was a legendary druid active in the North during the 15 century DR. He was known as the Hunter's Curse owing to his reputation for disrupting hunting events and for hunting hunters.
Darya Scattertrail was an unlucky gnome druid adventurer from the High Forest druidic circle in Northwest Faerûn, active sometime before the late 14 century DR.
Daviol the Frozen was an adventurer and the first owner of the pair of Aurilite magic boots – the Frost's Embrace, who lived some years before the mid 14 century DR.
Dart Dirtwood was a ranger and thug from the city of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.

Deathstar was a hobgoblin member of the Lostafinga tribe. He served under Lieutenant Julla and occupied a castle in the southern end of Kryptgarden Forest on the Sword Coast North in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. While the other hobgoblins slept, he played a game involving sticks, bones, and stones with Lucky and Jurmane. Deathstar was proficient with the halberd and morning star.
Dauphran Alskyte was a tradelord from Luskan in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. He was a suspect in the murder of Garthin Muirtree.
Davit Pence was a Cormyrean Purple Dragon who served in the town of Eveningstar in the late 15 century DR.
Darrigo Trumpettower was a nobleman of Athalantar in the 3 century DR.
Darrold was an inhabitant of Stag Falls in the mid-to-late 14 century DR, zombified by the vampire Romanisk Vlaensk despite being taken hostage.
Darvis was a gold dwarf laborer who worked for Flymm Cargo in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Baron Darthen Ironwright was a former member of the Company of the White Star. He retired to become lord of his own small hold near Scornubel. He was married and has a number of children.
Darvis Shennelm was the lord of the port city of Hlath in the nation of Chondath circa 1372 DR.
Deekin Scalesinger was a male kobold bard and adventurer in the North in the 1370s DR.
Delenia "Delly" Curtie a barmaid at The Cutlass tavern in Luskan and later the wife of Wulfgar, in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Deheriana was the lover of Kivan. She was tortured to death by Tazok, prompting Kivan to swear revenge.
Dela Alder was the proprietor of the Traveler's Cloak Inn within the city of Mulmaster.
Dendybar the Mottled was a wizard and the guardian of the northern spire in the Hosttower of the Arcane in the seaport city of Luskan in the mid-14 century DR.
Delkin Snowdawn is a human cleric of Lathander and leader of the adventuring group, the Moor Runners.
Deltara Dragynstarr was a human woman of the city of Tantras in the Vast. She was a bard and an important member of the Harpers in the city around 1358 DR.
Delmuth Echorn was the young elven heir of House Echorn in Cormanthyr at the time that Elminster Aumar was nominated Armathor.
Denak was an abjurer and a member of the Red Wizards of Thay.
Deior Rasthavin () was a sage and historian of Selgaunt and a regional agent of the Moonstars in the Year of the Tankard, 1370 DR.
Delgithnar was a quaggoth druid involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in 1375 DR.
Dell McCourt was a dwarf soldier of the Dagult Neverember army in Neverwinter.
Degasus Tarensun was a minor assassin of the Night Masks in 1370 DR.
Deinyn Fembrys was a male Chondathan human cleric of Shar. He was one of a group of Sharran clerics posing as clerics of Mystra at a false Temple of Mystra in Wheloon in Cormyr in 1374 DR.
Delacrae Gentleblossom was a sage and shopkeeper in Phlan in 1489 DR.
Del Geery was a human farmer in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the mid–14th century DR. He was notably prosperous and enterprising, particularly in the hydra trade.
Deriel Rethslane was a moon elf scout living in Cormanthor in the late 15 century DR.
Delitar the Slow was a historian working in Westgate in the mid–14 century DR. He was considered by many to be the greatest human historian in the Realms in 1358 DR.
Dekoran was a boatbuilder in Daggerford around 1370 DR. He lived in a house in the southeast section of Daggerford located on Hill Road near the River Gate.

Deleira Truesilver was a noble from Suzail and a lady of the Truesilver noble house of Cormyr in the late 15 century DR. She was also a cat burglar and slayer under cover of night, using the alias of Talane.
Derreg was a paladin of Amaunator at the Abbey of the Rose in Sembia in the mid–15 century DR.
Derlaunt was the ruler of Gheldaneth in Mulhorand in 1357 DR.
Dengor Bloodheart was a fire giant forgepriest of Surtr in the late 15 century DR.

Dei Chiang was the proprietor of a laundry in the Xiousing district of Marsember. Chiang had a difficult life after her husband, a Shou Purple Dragon knight, was killed in action. Alone, she tried to raise their six daughters. Chiang liked to know everything that happened in the quarter and was an active member of the xenophobic society known as The Chuen.
Dendrand Olaundran was a member of the Olaundran merchant family in Delzimmer circa the Year of Rogue Dragons, 1373 DR.
Deegan was a member of the Graycloaks faction of the Sons of Alagondar of Neverwinter in the late years of the 15 century DR.
Delora Sharpeye was an individual in the Western Heartlands around 1347 DR.
Deldrach Longarrow was a wild elf of the Misty Forest in the 14 centuries DR.
Deltoor Rillian was a druid of Chauntea in the Spiderhaunt Wood around the year 1369 DR.

Denton Crimsguard was one of the most fervent, and devoted priest of Tyr in the Vilhon Reach around the year 1370 DR. From his temple in the city of Alaghôn, Denton would lead impassioned speeches for his faithful every week.

The Deep Elder Doom was the highest-ranking member within the church of Myrkul up until the mid–14 century DR. They served as the head of the Conclave of Doom within the Skullspire in southern Faerûn.
Denderida was a drow trader and member of House Hunzrin in the late 15 century DR.
Deckon Thar was a bandit king and founding member of the royal line that led the Chieftains in Gold.
Dermin Courtierdale was a famous Harper master who operated out of Amn during the mid–14 century DR.
Degar Mindero was a commander of the Knights in Silver circa 1484 DR.
Deltagar Zelhund was one of the Overwizards of the Arcane Brotherhood in the 1360s DR.

Deep crows were massive bird-like insects. Aggressively predatory and possessors of an alien intelligence, these creatures were little known by sages, but feared by adventurers and spoken of only in hushed tones.
Dell Tannerson was a nephew of Rafferty Tannerson. Together, they regularly braved the elements traveling with caravans between Luskan and the Ten Towns in the late 1360s DR.
Denzelians were a strange, very rarely encountered species of subterranean creature that lacked any features.
Deldagg Huldgrym was a dwarven adventurer who founded the Bloodaxe Mercenary Company around 1317 DR.
Demetira Landscraper was the manager of the Happy Cow inn in Daggerford who helped Fulbar Hardcheese running the business, purchasing, and accounting circa 1372 DR.
Dennison the Jade was a devotee of Lathander who served the city of Myth Drannor as the senior priest in the late 7 and early 8 centuries DR.
Deker was a shepherd who lived in the village of Volkumburgh in the mid–14 century DR.
Morale Officer Deneld was an officer of the Shining Crusade that served at their military headquarters at Dragonspear Castle during the mid–14 century DR.
Decliz Ben'Zarafez was the matron mother of House Ben'Zarafez until the early 12 century DR.
Dempster Turmish was the Turami founder of the nation of Turmish.
Derezdreene was an older actress and a companion who worked at the Dryad's Dreams of Mosstone in Tethyr.
Derek Chisolm was a baker at the family-run Downunda Patisserie in Ravens Bluff in the Vast in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Derevan Crell was a Nentyarch of Narfell during the time of the Crell Dynasty.
Delebean was a rock gnome living in Gnomengarde in the late 15 century DR.
Deltar Tummarlin was a miller who lived in the village of Eveningstar during the late 14 century DR.
Demir Fenton was a commoner that lived in the Western Heartlands of Faerûn during the late 15 century DR.
Derryth Bonecloak was a shopkeep from Baldur's Gate that ran a business along with her husband Baelen during the late 15 century DR.
Deliah the White was one of the Masked Lords of Waterdeep that served her city for a time during the late 14 century DR.
Delfen's Tower was the home of the skilled wizard Delfen Ondabarl who inhabited the city of Daggerford in the Western Heartlands in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Derf was a businessman and tattoo artist inhabiting the city of Daggerford in the Western Heartlands during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Deldron Rein was a wealthy merchant of the Rein family of Loudwater in the Delimbiyr Vale in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

Dellanil Quil'quien was an elf king of Shilmista and one of the forest's legendary heroes. His writings were contained in an ancient tome. His son was Gil Telleman, and his descendants were Galladel and Elbereth.
Delric was one of the four bartenders who also worked as bouncers of the Copper Coronet in the River District of Athkatla, in the late 14 century DR.
Deluma Dauntrael was the matriarch of the Dauntrael clan as of the late mid-14 century DR.
Demitrick, nicknamed Old Scout, was a fisher and rebel of Targos in Icewind Dale in the mid–14 century DR.
